# Templates

43 ready-made set-ups. Look here first: if the request is one of these, `npm run render -- --template <id> --out <dir>` writes it, and `--explain` lists its parts with their anchors. A template is not a recipe: to change one, write a recipe of your own with the same symbols (`--template <id> --explain` gives the world position of every anchor, so that offsets can be copied).

Each entry gives the id, the title, the practicals it serves, the symbols it uses, and how it is set up.

## General

### heatingBeaker: Heating a liquid in a beaker

- practicals: General; Trilogy RP 8
- symbols: `heatproofMat`, `bunsenBurner`, `tripod`, `gauze`, `beaker`, `thermometer`
- set-up: Stack by anchors: mat, tripod, gauze, beaker; burner on the mat; thermometer in the liquid. Water 60 %.

## Chemistry

### filtration: Filtration

- practicals: Trilogy RP 8
- symbols: `conicalFlask`, `filterFunnel`, `filterPaper`
- set-up: Funnel stem in the flask mouth; filter paper in the funnel with residue; filtrate 15 % in the flask.

### crystallisation: Evaporating a solution

- practicals: Trilogy RP 8
- symbols: `heatproofMat`, `bunsenBurner`, `tripod`, `gauze`, `beaker`, `evaporatingBasin`
- set-up: A beaker of water (a water bath) on the gauze. The basin sits in the beaker mouth: its wall rests on the rim and its foot is inside the beaker. Solution 50 % in the basin.

### electrolysis: Electrolysis of a solution

- practicals: Trilogy RP 9
- symbols: `electrolysisCell`, `testTube`, `powerSupply`
- set-up: Solution 70 %. Two upside-down test tubes over the electrodes, their mouths below the solution surface. Gas in both tubes: the tube over the negative electrode holds about twice the volume of the other (as for sodium sulfate solution). Wires from the cell terminals to the power supply. Label the electrodes + and −.

### electrolysisBeaker: Electrolysis in a beaker

- practicals: Trilogy RP 9
- symbols: `beaker`, `lid`, `electrode`, `crocodileClip`, `powerSupply`
- set-up: Beaker with solution 60 %. Lid with two holes on the beaker rim; a carbon rod through each hole into the solution. A crocodile clip on the top of each rod; wires from the clips to the power supply. Label the electrodes + and −.

### temperatureChange: Temperature change in a polystyrene cup

- practicals: Trilogy RP 10; A-level RP 2
- symbols: `beaker`, `polystyreneCup`, `thermometer`
- set-up: Cup with lid, standing in a beaker (h 90), so that the cup rim is above the beaker rim. Thermometer through the lid hole. Solution 50 %.

### rateGasSyringe: Rate of reaction: gas syringe

- practicals: Trilogy RP 11; A-level RP 7
- symbols: `conicalFlask`, `bung`, `gasSyringe`, `clampStand`, `bossClamp`, `stopwatch`
- set-up: Glass tube from the bung to the syringe nozzle. Syringe held by the clamp. Acid 30 % (Colourless solution) with lumps and bubbles.

### rateGasOverWater: Rate of reaction: gas collected over water

- practicals: Trilogy RP 11; A-level RP 7
- symbols: `conicalFlask`, `bung`, `trough`, `measuringCylinder`, `stopwatch`, `clampStand`, `bossClamp`, `magnesiumRibbon`
- set-up: As the reference picture, with two changes. Magnesium ribbon lies in the acid in place of the chips. The upside-down measuring cylinder is held by a boss and clamp on a clamp stand. The acid is the Colourless solution preset.

### disappearingCross: Rate of reaction: disappearing cross

- practicals: Trilogy RP 11; A-level RP 3
- symbols: `conicalFlask`, `crossPaper`, `eye`, `stopwatch`, `thermometer`
- set-up: Flask on the paper's surface anchor, so the cross shows in front of the flask base. Eye above the flask, turned to look down into it (rot 90). Solution 35 %: the Cloudy yellow preset. Thermometer in the solution.

### paperChromatography: Paper chromatography

- practicals: Trilogy RP 12
- symbols: `beaker`, `chromatographyPaper`, `stirringRod`
- set-up: The glass rod lies across the beaker rim (rot 90) and the paper hangs from it. The paper's lower edge is in the solvent; its baseline is above the solvent surface. Solvent 12 %.

### simpleDistillation: Simple distillation (test tube)

- practicals: Trilogy RP 13
- symbols: `heatproofMat`, `bunsenBurner`, `tripod`, `gauze`, `conicalFlask`, `bung`, `thermometer`, `beaker`, `testTube`
- set-up: Flask on the gauze: salty water 30 % with anti-bumping granules (lumps 0.05). Two-hole bung. Delivery tube from just below the bung to a test tube; its end is above the collected liquid. The test tube stands in a beaker of ice and water: Ice lumps 0.55 with Water 0.05 above them. Thermometer through the second hole: its bulb is just below the bung, level with the delivery-tube inlet, not in the liquid.

### distillation: Distillation with a condenser

- practicals: Trilogy RP 13; A-level RP 5 and RP 10
- symbols: `roundBottomFlask`, `stillHead`, `thermometer`, `thermometerAdaptor`, `liebigCondenser`, `receiverAdaptor`, `conicalFlask`, `heatingMantle`, `clampStand`, `bossClamp`
- set-up: Flask in the heating mantle, with liquid 40 % and anti-bumping granules (lumps 0.05). Still head cone in the flask neck. Thermometer adaptor in the still-head socket; thermometer bulb level with the side arm. Condenser socket on the arm cone, so the condenser slopes down 18 degrees. Receiver adaptor on the condenser cone; its outlet is in the mouth of the conical flask, which has no bung: that is the one opening. Water in at the lower port and out at the upper port, with arrows. Clamps at the flask neck and at the condenser.

### titration: Titration

- practicals: A-level RP 1; GCSE Chemistry RP 2
- symbols: `clampStand`, `bossClamp`, `burette`, `conicalFlask`, `tile`
- set-up: Burette (acid) clamped upright, reading 0.00 with a meniscus; its tip is inside the flask neck, above the liquid. Flask on the white tile: alkali with phenolphthalein, 20 %, the Pink preset.

### flameTest: Flame test

- practicals: GCSE Chemistry RP 7
- symbols: `heatproofMat`, `bunsenBurner`, `flameTestLoop`
- set-up: Loop held in the edge of the blue flame.

### standardSolution: Making a standard solution

- practicals: A-level RP 1
- symbols: `volumetricFlask`, `filterFunnel`, `washBottle`, `beaker`
- set-up: Funnel in the flask neck. Solution in the bulb only, below the mark (about 40 %). Beaker and wash bottle beside the flask. A label on the neck: graduation mark.

### spiritBurnerCalorimetry: Enthalpy of combustion

- practicals: A-level RP 2
- symbols: `spiritBurner`, `copperCalorimeter`, `thermometer`, `clampStand`, `bossClamp`, `heatproofMat`
- set-up: Can clamped above the burner flame. Water 60 %. Thermometer in the water.

### reflux: Heating under reflux

- practicals: A-level RP 10
- symbols: `roundBottomFlask`, `liebigCondenser`, `heatingMantle`, `clampStand`, `bossClamp`
- set-up: Flask in the heating mantle, with liquid 40 % and anti-bumping granules (lumps 0.05). Condenser upright (rot 90) with its cone seated in the flask neck. Water in at the lower port and out at the upper port. The only opening is the top of the condenser: a label says so. Clamp at the flask neck.

### separatingFunnelUse: Separating two liquids

- practicals: A-level RP 10
- symbols: `separatingFunnel`, `clampStand`, `bossClamp`, `beaker`
- set-up: Funnel held by the clamp, stopper removed (stopper = false). Lower layer: aqueous, Water 35 %. Upper layer: organic, Oil or organic layer 25 %. Label both layers. Beaker under the stem.

### buchnerFiltration: Filtration under reduced pressure

- practicals: A-level RP 10
- symbols: `buchnerFunnel`, `bung`, `buchnerFlask`
- set-up: Funnel stem through a one-hole bung in the flask neck. Rubber tube from the side arm with a label: to pump. Powder layer on the filter paper; filtrate 15 % in the flask.

### meltingPoint: Measuring a melting point

- practicals: A-level RP 10
- symbols: `meltingPointApparatus`, `thermometer`, `capillaryTube`
- set-up: Thermometer and capillary tube in the block holes.

### tlc: Thin-layer chromatography

- practicals: A-level RP 12
- symbols: `beaker`, `watchGlass`, `chromatographyPaper`
- set-up: Plate (plate = true, h 90) leaning in the beaker. Solvent 10 %, below the baseline. Watch glass as the lid: its edge anchor on the beaker's rim anchor.

### electrochemicalCell: Electrochemical cell

- practicals: A-level RP 8
- symbols: `beaker`, `electrode`, `saltBridge`, `instrumentBox`
- set-up: Two beakers with strip electrodes and solutions of different tints. Salt bridge between them. Wires from the electrode tops to a meter box titled voltmeter (terminals = 2).

### phCurve: pH curve

- practicals: A-level RP 9
- symbols: `clampStand`, `bossClamp`, `burette`, `beaker`, `probe`, `instrumentBox`, `hotPlate`, `stirBar`
- set-up: Beaker on the hot plate (stirrer = true) with a stirrer bar. Probe in the solution, wire to the pH meter. Burette above.

### massLoss: Rate of reaction: loss of mass

- practicals: A-level RP 7
- symbols: `balance`, `conicalFlask`, `cottonWool`, `stopwatch`
- set-up: Flask on the balance pan with a cotton wool plug. Lumps, liquid and bubbles.

### testTubeReactions: Test-tube reactions

- practicals: A-level RP 4, RP 6 and RP 11; Trilogy RP 3
- symbols: `testTubeRack`, `testTube`, `dropper`
- set-up: Four test tubes in the rack with liquids of different tints; one with a precipitate (a powder layer from the precipitate presets). Dropper above one tube.

### thermalDecomposition: Heating a solid and testing the gas

- practicals: General
- symbols: `heatproofMat`, `bunsenBurner`, `clampStand`, `bossClamp`, `boilingTube`, `bung`, `testTubeRack`, `testTube`
- set-up: Boiling tube held by the clamp, sloping with its mouth a little higher than its closed end. Green powder at the closed end, above the Bunsen flame. One-hole bung. Delivery tube from the bung down into a test tube of limewater (Colourless solution 50 %, few bubbles) that stands in a rack (holes 3).

## Biology

### microscopeParts: Light microscope

- practicals: Trilogy RP 1
- symbols: `microscope`, `microscopeSlide`
- set-up: Slide on the stage. Labels for eyepiece, objective lenses, stage, coarse focus, fine focus, lamp.

### osmosis: Osmosis in plant tissue

- practicals: Trilogy RP 2
- symbols: `testTubeRack`, `boilingTube`, `potatoCylinder`, `balance`
- set-up: Five boiling tubes in a rack (holes 5, tube = boiling, w 250). Each tube holds a solution 60 % and a potato cylinder. Tube labels: 0.0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75 and 1.0 mol/dm³. Balance beside the rack.

### foodTestWaterBath: Food test in a water bath

- practicals: Trilogy RP 3
- symbols: `heatproofMat`, `bunsenBurner`, `tripod`, `gauze`, `beaker`, `testTube`, `thermometer`
- set-up: Test tube with blue solution standing in a beaker of hot water.

### enzymes: Effect of pH on amylase

- practicals: Trilogy RP 4
- symbols: `waterBath`, `testTube`, `thermometer`, `spottingTile`, `dropper`, `stopwatch`
- set-up: Two test tubes and a thermometer in the water bath. Spotting tile (iodine on, blueBlack 5) and dropper beside it.

### photosynthesis: Light intensity and photosynthesis

- practicals: Trilogy RP 5
- symbols: `lamp`, `ruler`, `beaker`, `boilingTube`, `pondweed`
- set-up: Boiling tube of water in a beaker of water. Pondweed in the tube with its cut end at the top (rot 180); many bubbles in the tube's water. Lamp at the left. Ruler on the bench between the lamp and the beaker.

### quadratSampling: Sampling with a quadrat

- practicals: Trilogy RP 7
- symbols: `quadrat`, `ruler`
- set-up: Quadrat beside a tape used as a transect line: a ruler with length 100 and numbers off. Label it tape measure.

## Physics

### specificHeatCapacity: Specific heat capacity

- practicals: Trilogy RP 14
- symbols: `heatproofMat`, `metalBlock`, `immersionHeater`, `thermometer`, `powerSupply`, `instrumentBox`
- set-up: Insulated block on the mat. Heater and thermometer in the block holes. Meter box titled joulemeter with four terminals: wires from the power supply to its input, and from its output to the heater.

### resistanceWire: Resistance of a wire

- practicals: Trilogy RP 15
- symbols: `cBattery`, `cSwitch`, `cAmmeter`, `cVoltmeter`, `cJunction`, `ruler`, `crocodileClip`
- set-up: Circuit: battery, switch and ammeter in series with a test wire along a ruler; voltmeter across the wire. Crocodile clips on the wire.

### resistorNetworks: Resistors in series and in parallel

- practicals: Trilogy RP 15
- symbols: `cBattery`, `cSwitch`, `cAmmeter`, `cResistor`, `cVoltmeter`, `cJunction`
- set-up: Two circuits side by side. Left: battery, switch, ammeter and two resistors in series, with a voltmeter across the two resistors. Right: the same, but the two resistors are in parallel. Junction dots where wires meet.

### ivCharacteristic: I-V characteristic

- practicals: Trilogy RP 16
- symbols: `cBattery`, `cVariableResistor`, `cAmmeter`, `cLamp`, `cVoltmeter`, `cJunction`
- set-up: Series loop: battery, variable resistor, ammeter, lamp. Voltmeter in parallel with the lamp. Junction dots where wires meet. The lamp can be changed for cResistor, or for cDiode in series with a protective cResistor.

### densityDisplacement: Density of an irregular solid

- practicals: Trilogy RP 17
- symbols: `displacementCan`, `measuringCylinder`, `irregularSolid`, `benchLine`
- set-up: Can (h 170) on the bench, full to the spout (amount 0.75), with the solid in the water on a thread (a line). Measuring cylinder (h 100) on the bench with its mouth under the end of the spout; water 20 %.

### densityLiquid: Density of a liquid

- practicals: Trilogy RP 17
- symbols: `balance`, `measuringCylinder`
- set-up: Measuring cylinder (numbers on) standing on the balance pan. Liquid at a reading of 60 cm³, with a meniscus. Balance reading 152.40 g.

### springExtension: Force and extension of a spring

- practicals: Trilogy RP 18
- symbols: `clampStand`, `bossClamp`, `spring`, `massHanger`, `ruler`
- set-up: Spring hangs from the clamp; hanger on the spring. Ruler upright beside the spring (rot 90). A line with an arrow as the pointer.

### acceleration: Force, mass and acceleration

- practicals: Trilogy RP 19
- symbols: `benchLine`, `trolley`, `pulley`, `massHanger`, `lightGate`, `instrumentBox`
- set-up: Trolley with card on the bench. String (a line) from the trolley over the pulley to the hanger. Two light gates stand on the bench astride the track, so the card passes through each beam. Wires from the gates to a meter box titled data logger.

### rippleTankWaves: Waves in a ripple tank

- practicals: Trilogy RP 20
- symbols: `rippleTank`, `ruler`
- set-up: Ripple tank with water. Ruler beside the screen. Labels for lamp, dipper, screen.

### wavesOnString: Waves on a string

- practicals: Trilogy RP 20
- symbols: `benchLine`, `vibrationGenerator`, `instrumentBox`, `woodenBridge`, `pulley`, `massHanger`
- set-up: String (a line) from the generator pin over a bridge and the pulley to the hanger. Meter box titled signal generator (terminals = 2), with wires to the generator.

### infraredRadiation: Infrared radiation from surfaces

- practicals: Trilogy RP 21
- symbols: `heatproofMat`, `leslieCube`, `infraredDetector`, `ruler`
- set-up: Leslie cube with hot water 85 %, on the mat. Detector pointing at one face. Ruler on the bench between them, and a dimension line for the distance.
